rv.q: The show, with a lively thrust set designed by Jeff Kmiec, certainly shows off what this new theater will be able to do without sacrificing its famously close relationship with its audience.
This is a great way to welcome area audiences into one of the local theater community’s newest playhouses.

cn.t: Critics welcome Northlight's new Evanston space with cautious optimism about this "The Front Page" revival, praising the high energy and beloved Chicago cast while questioning whether the 1928 satire needed updating.
